tasks.label: Jekyll: 本地预览 (livereload)
tasks.command: GEM_HOME="$PWD/vendor/gems" GEM_PATH="$PWD/vendor/gems" JEKYLL_NO_BUNDLER_REQUIRE=true ruby vendor/gems/bin/jekyll serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 --livereload

tasks.label: Jekyll: 构建 (_site)
tasks.command: GEM_HOME="$PWD/vendor/gems" GEM_PATH="$PWD/vendor/gems" JEKYLL_NO_BUNDLER_REQUIRE=true ruby vendor/gems/bin/jekyll build
